borrows.tell: clean — never reached in, never borrowed from The Man

ruling.SELF: REACHED-IN FAIL (David, 2026-11-15): reaching into its own piggy bank is a fail on the record — better than a full loss, the engine is still floating on profits, but a fail.
ruling.MAN: FULL FAIL (David, 2026-11-15): a borrow from THE MAN (the main bank) is a full fail — the run restarts.
ruling.PEER: A borrow from the other engines — counted on the record like every borrow.

lessons.what_happened: Called DOWN at 63% on a $-30 move from the open. BTC settled $+21 on the other side of the open. After the call the price reversed back through the open and never came back.
lessons.lesson: The cold band again: 60–70% calls are the desk's least honest range. Counted, printed, and the reason the real-money draft puts its floor at 0.70.

lessons.what_happened: Called DOWN at 65% on a $-25 move from the open. BTC settled $+3 on the other side of the open. After the call the price reversed back through the open and never came back.
lessons.lesson: Thin move + the cold band: a sub-70% call on a sub-$25 drift is the desk's known leak — this band has run near 50%, not its stated ~65%. The $5 rulebook's 0.70 floor exists because of calls like this.

lessons.what_happened: Called UP at 63% on a $+21 move from the open. BTC settled $-12 on the other side of the open. After the call the price reversed back through the open and never came back.
lessons.lesson: Thin move + the cold band: a sub-70% call on a sub-$25 drift is the desk's known leak — this band has run near 50%, not its stated ~65%. The $5 rulebook's 0.70 floor exists because of calls like this.

lessons.what_happened: Called UP at 67% on a $+30 move from the open. BTC settled $-30 on the other side of the open. The price never crossed back — it just kept drifting the wrong way.
lessons.lesson: The cold band again: 60–70% calls are the desk's least honest range. Counted, printed, and the reason the real-money draft puts its floor at 0.70.

lessons.what_happened: Called UP at 72% on a $+48 move from the open. BTC settled $-19 on the other side of the open. The price never crossed back — it just kept drifting the wrong way.
lessons.lesson: A clean miss at an honest price. Logged, counted, and left in the record — the desk does not edit its losses out.
